# 06 SIR Simulation School Intervention

## 1. Setup & Data Import

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(grid) 
library(Matrix)
library(tictoc)
library(igraph)

func_path = here('scripts', 'src')
rds_path = here('data', 'processed')
plot_path = here('output')

source(here(func_path, 'model_matrix_M2.R'))
source(here(func_path, 'model_BM.R'))
source(here(func_path, 'SIR_sim_func.R'))

N = 10000
I0 = 5
R0 = 2.5
d = 7
sim_period = 150
num_simulations = 100 

nodes = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'nodes_10k.rds'))

# Model 1
model_1 = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'BM_longrun1_20260303_064355.rds'))

# Model 2
model_2 = readRDS(here(rds_path,  'M2_Adaptive_Matrix_18_20260327_191045.rds'))
```

### Clean Posterior Distribution

**Model 1**

```{r model 1 clean up}
chain_m1 = model_1$chain

burn_in_ind = floor(model_1$config$n_iter * 0.2)
chain_m1 = chain_m1[-(1 : burn_in_ind), ]
```

**Model 2**

```{r model 2 clean up}
chain_m2 = model_2$chain

burn_in_ind = floor(model_2$config$n_iter * 0.2)
chain_m2 = chain_m2[-(1 : burn_in_ind), ]

# static data
static_data_m2 = get_static_data_m2_5(nodes, n_school = c(1, 1, 3, 4))
```

## 2. Compute R from Model 2

```{r}
# 1. Params
params_m2 = colMeans(chain_m2)
ages = nodes$part_age
rows = static_data_m2$rows
cols = static_data_m2$cols
age_diff = static_data_m2$age_diff


max_age_vec = pmax(ages[rows], ages[cols]) 

# 2. School Detection (Model 2 definition)
is_eligible = (ages[rows] >= 5 & ages[rows] <= 22) & (ages[cols] >= 5 & ages[cols] <= 22) & (
  (max_age_vec >= 5 & max_age_vec <= 8  & age_diff <= 1) | # Primary Low
  (max_age_vec >= 9 & max_age_vec <= 12 & age_diff <= 1) | # Primary High
  (max_age_vec >= 13 & max_age_vec <= 18 & age_diff <= 3) | # Secondary
  (max_age_vec >= 19 & max_age_vec <= 22 & age_diff <= 4)   # Tertiary
)
eligible_idx = which(is_eligible)

# safety check
if(length(eligible_idx) == 0) stop("Error: eligible_idx is empty. Check age conditions.")

# 3. Calculate probabilities only for eligible pairs
P_open_1k = calc_prob_m2_3(params_m2, static_data_m2)[eligible_idx]
logit_P_open = qlogis(P_open_1k) - log(N / 1000)

# School bonus (gamma * school_flag)
school_bonus = 
  params_m2['gamma_pri_low']  * static_data_m2$school_pri_low[eligible_idx] +
  params_m2['gamma_pri_high'] * static_data_m2$school_pri_high[eligible_idx] +
  params_m2['gamma_sec']      * static_data_m2$school_sec[eligible_idx] +
  params_m2['gamma_ter']      * static_data_m2$school_ter[eligible_idx]

logit_P_closed = logit_P_open - school_bonus

# 4. Compute R_value (plogis = 1/(1+exp(-x)))
P_open = plogis(logit_P_open)
P_closed = plogis(logit_P_closed)

R_value = mean(P_closed) / mean(P_open)

cat("Calculated R_value (School closure impact): ", R_value, "\n")
```

```         
Calculated R_value (School closure impact):  0.2217771
```

## 3. New Model 1 network that reduces inter-youth contacts

```{r new model 1 static data}

get_static_data_bm_interyouth = function(nodes) {
  N = nrow(nodes)
  upper_tri_ind = which(upper.tri(matrix(0, N, N)), arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  ages = nodes$part_age
  genders = nodes$part_gender
  rows = upper_tri_ind[, 1]
  cols = upper_tri_ind[, 2]
  
  # ------- For School Detection----
  age_diff = abs(ages[rows] - ages[cols])
  max_age = pmax(ages[rows], ages[cols])
  
  is_eligible = (ages[rows] >= 5 & ages[rows] <= 22) & 
                (ages[cols] >= 5 & ages[cols] <= 22) & (
    (max_age <= 8  & age_diff <= 1) | 
    (max_age <= 12 & age_diff <= 1) | 
    (max_age <= 18 & age_diff <= 3) |
    (max_age <= 22 & age_diff <= 4)
  )
  # ---------------------------------
  
  return(list(
    N = N,
    rows = rows,
    cols = cols,
    age_diff = age_diff,
    max_age = max_age,
    male_male = (genders[rows] == 'M' & genders[cols] == 'M') * 1,
    female_female = (genders[rows] == 'F' & genders[cols] == 'F') * 1,
    part_ages = ages,
    part_genders = genders,
    is_eligible = is_eligible
  ))
}

```

```{r new model 1 network generation}

generate_network_bm_interyouth = function(params, static_data, reduction_factor = 1.0) {
  
  # ----- parameters ---------------------
  
  alpha = params['alpha']
  theta = params['theta']
  phi_mm = params['phi_mm']
  phi_ff = params['phi_ff']
  sigma = params['sigma']
  
  N = static_data$N
  
  # ----- Random Effect -------------------
  
  epsilon = rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  
  # calculate the necessary pairs instead of creating an entire matrix
  re_sum_vec = epsilon[static_data$rows] + epsilon[static_data$cols]
  
  # ----- Logit ---------------------------
  logit_P = alpha +
    theta * static_data$age_diff +
    phi_mm * static_data$male_male +
    phi_ff * static_data$female_female +
    re_sum_vec
  
  logit_P_corrected = logit_P - log(N / 1000)
  
  prob_vec = plogis(logit_P_corrected)
  
  # Reduce the prob only for eligible pairs
  prob_vec[static_data$is_eligible] = prob_vec[static_data$is_eligible] * reduction_factor
  # ------------------------------
  
  edge_vec = rbinom(n = length(prob_vec), size = 1, prob = prob_vec)
  
  connected_indices = which(edge_vec == 1)
  if (length(connected_indices) > 0) {
    return(list(rows = static_data$rows[connected_indices],
                cols = static_data$cols[connected_indices],
                has_edge = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(list(has_edge = FALSE))
  }
}
```

## 4. ER model with intervention

```{r}
apply_intervention_to_er = function(er_adj_list, nodes, reduction_factor) {
  num_sims = length(er_adj_list)
  er_interv_list = list()
  N = nrow(nodes)
  ages = nodes$part_age
  
  for (i in 1:num_sims) {
    adj = er_adj_list[[i]]
    
    # upper triangle indices
    edges = which(adj != 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
    edges = edges[edges[, 1] < edges[, 2], , drop = FALSE] 
    
    rows = edges[, 1]
    cols = edges[, 2]
    
    age_rows = ages[rows]
    age_cols = ages[cols]
    age_diff = abs(age_rows - age_cols)
    max_age = pmax(age_rows, age_cols)
    
    # school flag
    is_eligible_edge = (age_rows >= 5 & age_rows <= 22) & 
                       (age_cols >= 5 & age_cols <= 22) & (
      (max_age <= 8  & age_diff <= 1) | 
      (max_age <= 12 & age_diff <= 1) | 
      (max_age <= 18 & age_diff <= 3) |
      (max_age <= 22 & age_diff <= 4)
    )
    
    # reduce prob
    keep_prob = ifelse(is_eligible_edge, reduction_factor, 1.0)
    keep_edge = rbinom(n = length(keep_prob), size = 1, prob = keep_prob)
    
    keep_idx = which(keep_edge == 1)
    new_rows = rows[keep_idx]
    new_cols = cols[keep_idx]
    
    # new adjacent matrix
    if (length(new_rows) > 0) {
      new_adj = sparseMatrix(
        i = c(new_rows, new_cols),
        j = c(new_cols, new_rows),
        x = 1, dims = c(N, N)
      )
    } else {
      new_adj = Matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = N, sparse = TRUE)
    }
    
    er_interv_list[[i]] = new_adj
  }
  
  cat("ER Intervention Network Generated!\n")
  return(er_interv_list)
}
```

## 6. Run Simulations (4 Models)

```{r read networks}
sim_adj_list_m1 = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'sim_adj_list_m1.rds'))
sim_adj_list_m2 = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'sim_adj_list_m2.rds'))
sim_adj_list_m1_interv = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'sim_adj_list_m1_interv.rds'))
sim_adj_list_m2_interv = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'sim_adj_list_m2_interv.rds'))
er_adj_list = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'er_adj_list.rds'))
er_adj_list_interv = readRDS(here(rds_path, "er_adj_list_interv.rds"))
```

```{r run-simulations}
tic("Total Simulation Time")

# Compure rho from ER network
k_er = mean(sapply(er_adj_list, function(x) sum(x)/N))
rho_er = -log(1 - R0 / k_er) / d

# 1. Erdos-Renyi (Intervention)
res_er = stochastic_sir_simulations(er_adj_list, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 500)
res_er_interv = stochastic_sir_simulations(er_adj_list_interv, fixed_rho = rho_er, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 500)


# Compure rho from M1 network
k_m1 = mean(sapply(sim_adj_list_m1, function(x) sum(x)/N))
rho_m1 = -log(1 - R0 / k_m1) / d

# 2. Model 1 (Intervention)
res_m1 = stochastic_sir_simulations(sim_adj_list_m1, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 600)

res_m1_interv = stochastic_sir_simulations(sim_adj_list_m1_interv, fixed_rho = rho_m1, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 600)


# Same procedure for M2 network
res_m2 = stochastic_sir_simulations(sim_adj_list_m2, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 700)

k_m2 = mean(sapply(sim_adj_list_m2, function(x) sum(x)/N))
rho_m2 = -log(1 - R0 / k_m2) / d

# 4. Model 2 (Intervention)
res_m2_interv = stochastic_sir_simulations(sim_adj_list_m2_interv, fixed_rho = rho_m2, d = d, R0 = R0, seed = 700)

toc()
```

```{r}
saveRDS(res_er, file.path(rds_path, "res_er_r0_25.rds"))
saveRDS(res_er_interv, file.path(rds_path, "res_er_interv_r0_25.rds"))
saveRDS(res_m1, file.path(rds_path, "res_m1_r0_25.rds"))
saveRDS(res_m2, file.path(rds_path, "res_m2_r0_25.rds"))
saveRDS(res_m1_interv, file.path(rds_path, "res_m1_interv_r0_25.rds"))
saveRDS(res_m2_interv, file.path(rds_path, "res_m2_interv_r0_25.rds"))
```
